cards.title: Matterhorn project strategy
cards.progress: Matterhorn is a deterministic, evidence-backed L3 temporal memory layer with LLM-confined writes and deterministic projected reads. Its public package is matterhorn-memory, its Python import is matterhorn, and its default facade is add(messages) plus matters(scope_id). Thread identity is the first matter boundary; revocation changes evidence status without deleting conclusions; SQLite and PostgreSQL share the same golden conformance contract; the latest listed release is 0.6.0.
